reviews.text:
do not hire rafaelle!!! he does extremely sloppy work, has no attention to detail, does not know how to do basic bathroom remodeling tasks like cutting straight tile to fit a shower curb, tiling an already sloped drain pan that i paid $175 for, or hand laying tile. he will make every excuse imaginable, doesn't have the money to pay his workers (who brought their little KIDS to my home and left outside!!) and is not someone you want to trust with doing construction work in your home!!! he had no idea why a tile wasn't laying right and all he had to do was open his eyes. i do not remodel bathrooms and could clearly tell why. he is a scam artist.

ultimately, he stole my money and left me with tiles sticking up on my shower floor that are ugly and HURT MY FEET! i CANT use
my shower and have to hire someone else to fix his mess! BEWARE!!
Raffaele did an amazing job remodeling my entire bathroom, and also fixed my leak that someone else I hired messed up and made worse. Definitely would recommend 👍🏻 …
